dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! The movie theater is upstairs.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ðə ˈmuːvi ˌθiːətər ɪz ˌʌpˈstɛrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Two tickets, please. What time does the Thai movie start?
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː ˈtɪkɪts, ˈpliːz. ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm dʌz ðə ˈtaɪ ˈmuːvi ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: At five o'clock. Row C or row H?
dialogue.reading: ət ˈfaɪv əˈklɑːk. ˈroʊ ˈsiː ɔːr ˈroʊ ˈeɪtʃ?
